items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Glover Compton was telling me the other day of Ollie Powers

ctx.x: It's been so long, you know. And, uh, uh, we worked there, that was back in, well that must have been 20, that was back in 26, I guess, I don't know, 27. And, uh, I worked with, uh, let's see, there's another fella, had a band, yeah, I don't think you've ever heard of him, cause he didn't get very popular.
There was one band, Glover Compton was telling me the other day of Ollie Powers, worked at the Dreamland too, he was the singer and drummer.

Yes, yes, Ollie Powers was singing there when I was there with Leo, uh huh, yeah, Ollie Powers. And, uh, then he started to drumming there with, uh, I think some, uh, shit. Yeah, he, he, he was, he was very good too, very good singer.
